text: Founded Hyosan LPL Co., Ltd. & Commenced surface material production(Incheon, South Korea)
Founded ICC (Established Korea’s first & largest simultaneous production line for Finishing Foil and LPM)
Awarded the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy's Commendation
Patent Application (Super PET UV Foil & LPM for coating)
Developed HI FLEX low-bending LPM & Registered patent for Fire-Retardant LPM FF
Founded JF Chem (Specialized resin production / Achieved vertical integration of raw materials)
Founded HI-VINA JSC in Vietnam (Joint venture by Hyosan & ICC)
Installed advanced machinery & Commenced supply of high-quality LPM and MFB to the Vietnamese market
Installed Production Line No. 2 (6-foot impregnation line) at HI-VINA Vietnam factory
Official Launch of 'Hyosan Group' and transition into the unified global corporate structure
